pages.title: The Dragon Panel
pages.text: Your companion's panel has Details, Dragon Equipment, and Knowledge Level tabs. The current tab is dimmed; select another to switch.$(br2)Accessory slots unlock at knowledge levels one, two, and three. Read $(l:dragonmaid:learning/books)Lessons and Lore$(/l) for advancement.

pages.title: Unable to Transform
pages.text: Name the dragon, reach stage three and 300 knowledge, land, and end riding. Try the transformation button in an open space.$(br2)Study with books, manuscripts, or bottles o' enchanting.

pages.title: Where to Find Help
pages.text: For injury or stone, read $(l:dragonmaid:care/injury)Wounds and Stone$(/l) and $(l:dragonmaid:care/injury#petrification)the remedy pages$(/l). Furnace trouble? See $(l:dragonmaid:care/forge)At the Dragonforge$(/l); swimming? See $(l:dragonmaid:forms/water)Beneath the Surface$(/l).$(br2)Empty hands: Shift-right-click for the panel; right-click to change behavior.
